<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Work and Live in Austria" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="APPLICANT" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>splitNegotiate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>negotiateAccommodation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>negotiateBank</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>joinNegotiate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>prepareDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>provideMissing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="REPRESENTATION" name="Austrian representation office (BMEIA)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gwCompetent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>redirect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>redirected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gwComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>requestMissing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decideVisa</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gwRefusal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>refuseVisa</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>refused</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>issueVisa</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>issued</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Plan to work and live in Austria" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="splitNegotiate" name="Negotiate in parallel" />
    <bpmn:task id="negotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation" />
    <bpmn:task id="negotiateBank" name="Negotiate bank account" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="joinNegotiate" />
    <bpmn:task id="prepareDocuments" name="Prepare visa application documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="submitApplication" name="Submit visa application" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gwCompetent" name="Competent representation?" />
    <bpmn:task id="redirect" name="Redirect application to competent representation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="redirected" name="Application redirected" />
    <bpmn:task id="checkApplication" name="Check the application" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gwComplete" name="Application complete?" />
    <bpmn:task id="requestMissing" name="Request missing documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="provideMissing" name="Provide missing documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="decideVisa" name="Decide on the visa application" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gwRefusal" name="Grounds for refusal?" />
    <bpmn:task id="refuseVisa" name="Refuse the visa" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="refused" name="Visa refused" />
    <bpmn:task id="issueVisa" name="Issue Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="issued" name="Visa issued" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="splitNegotiate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="splitNegotiate" targetRef="negotiateAccommodation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="splitNegotiate" targetRef="negotiateBank" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="negotiateAccommodation" targetRef="joinNegotiate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="negotiateBank" targetRef="joinNegotiate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="joinNegotiate" targetRef="prepareDocuments" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="prepareDocuments" targetRef="submitApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="submitApplication" targetRef="gwCompetent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" name="no" sourceRef="gwCompetent" targetRef="redirect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="redirect" targetRef="redirected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" name="yes" sourceRef="gwCompetent" targetRef="checkApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="checkApplication" targetRef="gwComplete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="no" sourceRef="gwComplete" targetRef="requestMissing" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="requestMissing" targetRef="provideMissing" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="provideMissing" targetRef="checkApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" name="yes" sourceRef="gwComplete" targetRef="decideVisa" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="decideVisa" targetRef="gwRefusal" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" name="yes" sourceRef="gwRefusal" targetRef="refuseVisa" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f19" sourceRef="refuseVisa" targetRef="refused" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f20" name="no" sourceRef="gwRefusal" targetRef="issueVisa" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f21" sourceRef="issueVisa" targetRef="issued" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
